n54aacf1a5c.headline: Urgent to curb excessive CFE charges
n54aacf1a5c.summary: Concanaco Servytur, a Mexican business confederation, calls for dialogue to find solutions to excessive electricity charges imposed by CFE, Mexico's state electricity company.
n54aacf1a5c.why: Electricity costs are a significant input for Mexican businesses, and high charges can affect competitiveness and inflation.

n8f55aba1c8.headline: The real estate market will pick up even more soon
n8f55aba1c8.summary: An economic expert forecasts a lively real estate market in Hungary in the coming months driven by stronger than average demand.
n8f55aba1c8.why: Real estate market trends impact economic growth, investment, and consumer wealth in Hungary.
